text.p: These are the leading stories in the Tunisian press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- President Ben Ali asked Prime Minister Hamed Karoui to open on Tuesday the International meeting on foreign financing of the ninth development plan 1997-2001. More than 40 countries participating.
- Agriculture Minister Mabrouk Bahri presented a report on prospects for summer's crops to President Ben Ali.
- President Ben Ali asked Agriculture Minister Mabrouk Bahri to reinforce agriculture production in order to reach self-sufficiency by the year 2000.
- Tunisia on Wednesday is to celebrate Environment Day. 600,000 dinars to municipalities for environment projects.
